ig_caption:
Every agent harness has the same 6 parts 🧩

1️⃣ Loop: think, act, check, repeat
2️⃣ Tools: functions it can call
3️⃣ Context: what it sees each turn (and what you leave out)
4️⃣ Memory: what survives between steps and sessions
5️⃣ Rules: what it must always follow
6️⃣ Guardrails: permissions, limits, approvals

Miss one and your agent breaks in a very predictable way. Save this 🔖

Part 3/6 of Agent Harness 101. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
